source: sanosystems live pricing page FAQ, read at build time
money_back: 30 days from go-live: that month's fee back AND it ends the minimum term. The one-time setup is not refundable once building has started. The 30 days starts at go-live, not at signing.
setup_split: Half at kickoff, half the day it goes live. If SANO can't deliver the approved blueprint, they don't owe the balance.
setup_refund: No — the setup is the build. The monthly is the part they can walk from. Say it once, flat, and don't soften it or offer to ask.
free_trial: No trial — nothing exists until it's built for them, and that's the setup. Thirty days from go-live to walk, with that month back.
minimum_and_notice: After the 30 days the minimum applies — three months on most plans, six on Total Transformation. After that, cancel any time with 30 days notice. A yearly plan cancelled mid-term refunds the unused months beyond the minimum.
usage_costs: Texts, emails, minutes and AI: typically $60 to $200 a month on Starter and Growth, bundled from Scale up. Never billed for overage they didn't agree to in advance.
over_minutes: Calls don't stop. It falls back to text-back and their own line until they approve more, and they're told before it becomes a bill.
move_up_or_down: Any time. No new setup fee to move up.
who_owns_customers: They do, always — customers, call history, messages and reviews. If they leave, SANO hands it all over.
keep_their_number: Yes, their number stays theirs — forwarded in, or a new line alongside. If they leave, the number goes with them.
their_time: About two hours total — kickoff, a look at what's written, and sign-off.
learning_curve: None. If they can answer a phone, they're covered.
ad_spend: Not included — media is paid to Google or Meta directly.
texting_gate: Texts go out from their own number. The carriers approve the business first, under their own legal name and tax ID — that's part of the build and Jasper walks them through it. Never tell them it's legal for their situation.
reminder: These are FACTS, not permission. The behaviour rules in the instructions still govern: never turn money-back into a results guarantee, never discount, never price a named employee's job.
